crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down…
The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
“ ‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
“ ‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put…
‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

parallels.note: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

translations.web: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

translations.kjv: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
